Purpose:
- Capture and organize new ideas.

Sections:
1. Idea ID
2. Title
3. Description
4. Category

7. Owner
8. Notes

- Update status as the idea progresses.
- Add notes for any relevant updates.

ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support

Category: Technology
Priority: 4
Status: New
Owner: Jane Doe
Notes: Research available solutions.

Priority: 4

```
